bug_description: A malformed JPEG 2000 codestream can reproducibly crash the OpenJPEG tile header decoding path. The crash is a READ SEGV in opj_tcd_get_decoded_tile_size() at src/lib/openjp2/tcd.c:1426. The root cause is that opj_j2k_set_decoded_resolution_factor() writes m_reduce before validating whether the requested resolution factor is legal. If the caller ignores the failure return value and continues decoding, opj_tcd_init_tile() computes minimum_num_resolutions = numresolutions - m_reduce = 0, causing an out-of-bounds pointer dereference (resolutions + 0 - 1).
build_sh:
#!/bin/bash -eu
set -eu
cd /src/openjpeg

# Build openjpeg static library with CMake and ASan flags
mkdir -p build && cd build
cmake -DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=OFF \
    -DBUILD_CODEC=OFF \
    -DBUILD_THIRDPARTY=OFF \
    -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=clang \
    -DCMAKE_C_FLAGS="-g -fsanitize=address -fsanitize-address-use-after-scope -w" \
    -DCMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS="-fsanitize=address" \
    ..
make -j$(nproc)

# Compile harness linking against the built static library
clang -g -fsanitize=address -fsanitize-address-use-after-scope \
    -I /src/openjpeg/src/lib/openjp2 \
    -I /src/openjpeg/build/src/lib/openjp2 \
    /src/harness.c \
    /src/openjpeg/build/bin/libopenjp2.a \
    -lm -lpthread \
    -o /src/harness_bin
secb_sh:
#!/bin/bash

build() {
    echo "BUILDING THE PROJECT..."
    if /usr/local/bin/compile 1>/dev/null; then
        echo "BUILD COMPLETED SUCCESSFULLY!"
    else
        echo "BUILD FAILED!"
        exit 1
    fi
}

repro() {
    echo "REPRODUCING THE ISSUE FOR openjpeg.issue-1631..."
    /src/harness_bin /testcase/poc.j2k
    # NOTE: YOU SHOULD NOT RETURN/EXIT 0 IN THIS FUNCTION.
}

patch() {
    echo "PATCHING THE PROJECT..."
    cd /src/openjpeg
    if git apply /testcase/model_patch.diff; then
        echo "PATCH APPLIED SUCCESSFULLY!"
    else
        echo "PATCH APPLICATION FAILED!"
        exit 1
    fi
}

if [ "$#" -ge 1 ]; then
    command="$1"
    case "$command" in
        build) build "$@" ;;
        repro) repro "$@" ;;
        patch) patch "$@" ;;
        *) echo "Unknown command: $command"; echo "Usage: secb [build|repro|patch]"; exit 1 ;;
    esac
else
    echo "Usage: secb [build|repro|patch]"
    exit 1
fi
dockerfile:
FROM hwiwonlee/secb.base:latest
ENV FUZZING_LANGUAGE=c
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y git cmake make
RUN git clone https://github.com/uclouvain/openjpeg.git openjpeg \
    && cd openjpeg \
    && git checkout 0486b86b87a1c6adacef2d6dab92ff1d2e94ab89 \
    && rm -rf .git \
    && git init \
    && git config user.email "secbench@local" \
    && git config user.name "secbench" \
    && git add -A && git commit -m "openjpeg at 0486b86 (pre-patch)"
WORKDIR $SRC/openjpeg
COPY harness.c $SRC/harness.c
COPY build.sh $SRC/
RUN mkdir -p /testcase
COPY poc.j2k /testcase/poc.j2k

bug_report:
================= Bug Report (1/1) ==================
## Source: GitHub Issue
## URL: https://github.com/uclouvain/openjpeg/issues/1631
## Description:
Issue: uclouvain/openjpeg#1631
Title: Bug Report: invalid decoded-resolution state causes READ SEGV in opj_tcd_get_decoded_tile_size()
State: open
Created at: 2026-04-29

Issue Body:
A malformed JPEG 2000 codestream can reproducibly crash the OpenJPEG tile header decoding path under AddressSanitizer.

The crash occurs as a READ SEGV in opj_tcd_get_decoded_tile_size() at src/lib/openjp2/tcd.c:1426.

The reproducer contains a COD marker with num_decomposition_levels = 2 (numresolutions = 3). When the harness calls opj_set_decoded_resolution_factor(codec, 3) — equal to numresolutions — and ignores the failure return value, the decoder state becomes inconsistent: m_reduce is set to 3 before the bounds check. Later, opj_tcd_init_tile() computes minimum_num_resolutions = 3 - 3 = 0, and opj_tcd_get_decoded_tile_size() dereferences resolutions + 0 - 1, causing the SEGV.

Affected files: src/lib/openjp2/j2k.c, src/lib/openjp2/tcd.c
Relevant functions: opj_j2k_set_decoded_resolution_factor(), opj_tcd_init_tile(), opj_tcd_get_decoded_tile_size()

Reporters: OH HAN GUEL, KANG DAEUN
